{"question":"按叙述顺序仅检索药圃停钟记录1及此前章节。","operation":"chapter-cutoff","view":"author","branch":"canon","retrievalStatus":"matched","diagnostics":[],"documents":[{"documentId":"D1","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"罗杉相信停钟使药苗枯萎；辛禾拆开水管，知道泥块堵塞才是已查明原因。辛禾依据堵塞记录准备清管，没有把敲钟列为修复步骤。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-J1YK","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A41d28fc6-b7a3-4946-84c6-08371b208383:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:41d28fc6-b7a3-4946-84c6-08371b208383"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["罗杉相信停钟使药苗枯萎；辛禾拆开水管，知道泥块堵塞才是已查明原因。辛禾依据堵塞记录准备清管，没有把敲钟列为修复步骤。"]},{"documentId":"D2","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"石匠在山门石阶刻下捐款名单，不接触药圃的钟或水管。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-J1YK","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A459c3005-bd67-4ec3-9075-7726c2b5aabb:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:459c3005-bd67-4ec3-9075-7726c2b5aabb"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["石匠在山门石阶刻下捐款名单，不接触药圃的钟或水管。"]},{"documentId":"D3","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"药圃供水管被泥块堵住，水流中断后药苗枯萎；同日下午院钟停了，但钟与水管没有连接。药圃规约写明：修复供水须清除管内堵塞，敲钟不影响水流。药牌上的字迹略微褪色。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-J1YK","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A761bdd8b-29b6-46d1-a339-9ae36c2cadec:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:761bdd8b-29b6-46d1-a339-9ae36c2cadec"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["药圃供水管被泥块堵住，水流中断后药苗枯萎；同日下午院钟停了，但钟与水管没有连接。药圃规约写明：修复供水须清除管内堵塞，敲钟不影响水流。药牌上的字迹略微褪色。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"辛禾清除泥块后供水恢复，救苗目标完成；罗杉依旧把成果归功于恰好响起的一次钟声。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-J1YK","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3A953f809f-f03f-466d-9760-67e0c4d687f1:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:953f809f-f03f-466d-9760-67e0c4d687f1"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["辛禾清除泥块后供水恢复，救苗目标完成；罗杉依旧把成果归功于恰好响起的一次钟声。"]}]}
